anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS format, which is the format used by this dataset.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: The paper describes the EEG-BIDS standard, which is the data organization standard used by this dataset (BIDS Version 1.9.0).

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels in standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz sampling rate. Subjects (ALS patients) performed a P300 speller task with visual stimulus presentations in a 6x6 character grid format. Data were processed and organized using MOABB (Mother of All BCI Benchmarks) version 1.5.0 according to BIDS 1.9.0 standards with HED 8.4.0 event annotations.
